programs.title: Yellowstone Wardens
programs.desc: Wardens must be cautious as they release a trapped black bear back into the wild; they pull together all their resources to stop illegal hunting in the valley.

programs.title: Yellowstone Wardens
programs.desc: Wardens kick off "Operation Caviar," enforcing a strict one-fish limit; other wardens conduct spot checks for licenses and tags, aiming to protect fish populations and promote responsible fishing.

programs.desc: Warden Taylor looks into hunters reported on a property without the landowner's permission; Warden Burroughs makes a tough decision when deer get their antlers stuck during a fight; Wardens Holland and Taylor investigate elk hunters harassing a herd.

programs.title: Yellowstone Wardens
programs.desc: Warden Kuka catches a repeat offender in the act; Warden Holland finds that someone fishing without a license also has a warrant out for his arrest; Wardens Taylor and Burroughs use an elk decoy to entice hunters.

programs.title: Yellowstone Wardens
programs.desc: Wardens uncover a crime scene while others patrol summer crowds, issuing fines for littering and DUI; amidst the chaos, Captain Jeff Darrah retires after 26 years, leaving a legacy of dedication and bravery.
